logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting job illustration for WO-01, a water-pump selection for a water-reclamation transfer loop. Show a simplified side-view schematic of the transfer loop: an upstream reclamation basin feeding a pump station with the selected module, discharging through a fixed-flow/fixed-head duty line to a reuse distribution header. Overlay a small pump-curve inset showing the common duty point (fixed flow and head) where all four candidate modules (P1, P2, P3, P4) were tested on the identical acceptance-run basis, with the measured energies 12, 52, 56 and 58 kWh labeled per candidate and the selected-package marker on P2. Style: clean engineering schematic, muted blue palette, no decorative elements; all labels legible and analytical.
